name: Ellis
note: The will that returns. Speaks choices in the body's mouth.

name: Narration
note: Spare staging. Not a narrator-god and not a quest log.

name: The Voice
note: Certification grammar. One account of the wound: the record is the act.

name: The Other Voice
note: The body's account of the same wound: the hands were late, and the hands were the act.
